描述_ZN: Fan Page of "Inquiring the Way", Ming, painted by Cui Zizhong, on gold paper with color, 20.8 cm in length and 60.2 cm in width.　　The fan page is self-titled: "Cui Zizhong." Inscription: "Zizhong" in vermilion.　　The picture depicts a young man bowing to an old man, while the old man raises his hand and points in reply, hence the title of this painting. Cui Zizhong's figure painting is innovative based on the traditional brushwork of Gu Kaizhi, Lu Tanwei, Yan Liben and Wu Daozi. He paid attention to the portrayal of characters' expressions, and in his "Washing Elephant", "Hidden Cloud" and "Fishing Family" in the collection of the National Palace Museum, he was able to accurately paint the characteristics of characters with different identities. In this painting, his humble expression when the young man asks questions and the confident and calm demeanor of the old man are both vividly conveyed. The rounded and delicate brushwork of the clothing pattern, the trembling lines, and the gnarled folds highlight the soft texture of the clothing material and its movement with the wind. The branches and leaves of the trees are filled in with double lines, and the brushwork is meticulous and decorative.
